## HAPI v0.27.2.3

### Compared with the previous maintained release

Rebuilt from current `upstream/main` (d147ae00a) with the maintained distribution overlay and carries. Inherits five upstream fixes since v0.27.2.2 (#1483 storageUsagePie→storageUsageSlices macOS case-collision, #1487 cursor ACP thinking bump on harness wake, #1493 claudeRemote test timeout, #1494 hidden history actions, #1479 Pi mid-turn LLM errors). New carries: scroll chaining from reasoning panel (#1501), lazy render collapsed reasoning (#1498), persist directory expansion (#1497), Telegram Mini App chrome (#1496), hide chat focus outline (#1495), Windows file-search separator normalization (#1490), single-tilde markdown (#1471), AGENT_NOTIFY_SUMMARY compact metadata (#1462, merged with the #1477 display toggle), Pi queue mid-turn messages with native steer (#1480), and ACP between-turn straggler flush (#1484). (#1473 peer provenance was reviewed and deferred this cycle — deep V28-schema conflicts, revisit next cycle.) Retains all prior carries (#1091, #987, #986, #847, #1108, #1424, #1422, #1414, #1413, #1158, #955, #906, #1436, #1421, #1419, desktop #769, #1469, #1468, #1475, #1474, #1451, #1418, #1477, #1447, #1429, #1360) plus the fork session-roots guard and schema V28 repair.

### Compared with the official release

Same maintained overlay as `v0.27.2.2` plus the carries above, rebuilt on `upstream/main` d147ae00a (everything up to official `v0.27.2`). Desktop launcher packaging (#769) remains included with the four-part-version and bun-layout packaging fixes.

### Maintained-fork guarantees

Release tags are published only from commits contained in `main`; macOS artifacts retain the `xyz.hapi.cli` signing identity; app-shell cache headers remain no-store. GitHub auto-generated release notes are never published — the curated notes in this file are used instead.
